title: Lighthouse Active Profile State
description: The record shape lighthouse.active_profile_store persists: exactly which intelligence profile is active, or the explicit declaration that none is (LHP-PROFILE-14B/01E, ADR-0016). Absence is DECLARED via activation_state='no_active_profile' — never inferred from missing data, never a default. No half states: an 'active' record carries all five identity facts valid and present plus digest-covered activation evidence references; a 'no_active_profile' record carries all identity and evidence fields as exactly null. Initial activation is local-only via profile_activation (LHP-V1-PROFILE-01C/01E). This document is a human/Gateway-facing reference mirror; the AUTHORITATIVE enforcer is modules/active_profile_state.py (ActiveProfileState.validate(), which also RECOMPUTES artifact_digest).

schema_version.description: Contract version. Unknown/future versions fail closed.

activation_state.description: The explicit discriminator: absence of an active profile is a declared state, not an inference.

active_profile_id.description: Which profile is active (null iff no_active_profile).

active_profile_version.description: Version of the active profile (null iff no_active_profile).

activated_at.description: Timezone-aware ISO-8601 activation time (null iff no_active_profile). Digest-covered.

active_profile_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the active profile's full canonical content at activation time (null iff no_active_profile).

transition_preview_id.description: Transition preview identity bound at activation (null iff no_active_profile).

transition_preview_digest.description: SHA-256 over the transition preview artifact content (null iff no_active_profile).

backup_manifest_id.description: Backup manifest identity bound at activation (null iff no_active_profile).

backup_manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 over the backup manifest file bytes (null iff no_active_profile).

verification_report_digest.description: SHA-256 over the verification report file bytes (null iff no_active_profile).

restore_report_digest.description: SHA-256 over the restore-drill report file bytes (null iff no_active_profile).

source_data_root.description: Normalized source data snapshot root bound at activation (null iff no_active_profile).

backup_root.description: Normalized verified backup root bound at activation (null iff no_active_profile).

artifact_digest.description: SHA-256 over the canonical record content (sort_keys, compact separators). Excludes ONLY itself.
